question_text: Electric cars are expensive to own, and recharging stations are not readily available. Unlike cars that run on fossil fuels, electric cars produce no carbon monoxide when being driven. Which of the following best explains why people choose to use this technology?
choices: A: The technology is a scientific advancement.
B: Electric cars store energy in batteries.
C: The technology is environmentally friendly.
D: Everyone is getting an electric car.
